title: PaperUpdater
description: A PlayerCONSOLE expansion that updates the paper / velocity jars to the latest builds
body:
![Visual](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/204b97d10801e5651ba9dc3351be99983e8de954.png)


**[PlayerCONSOLE](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/%E2%9C%A8%E3%80%90%E2%98%85-player%E2%9C%A6console-%E2%98%85%E3%80%91%E2%9C%A8-%E2%8E%AE-remote-panel-50-off-%E2%8E%AE-auto-restart-velocity-file-db-managing-api.126241/) is REQUIRED!**


<details>
<summary>Text version</summary>
PaperUpdater is a PlayerCONSOLE module that keeps your Paper or Velocity server on the
latest build automatically. Checks the PaperMC API on every startup and
downloads a new build only when one is available, in-place, no manual work.
Supports version pinning (Paper) and works on both Paper and Velocity.
Why this?
This skips the manual labor of reminding yourself to update the build, and this does it for you. Another key detail is that the build downloaded are usually older than the latest ones, as the ones on the API need to be updated by papermc manually, so these are more earlier builds. 
</details>
